Game Overview

In Shape Shifting Cells, the core idea is straightforward: guide B-12, a cute robot, on a thrilling ascent to activate a mysterious button. Navigate delicate challenges with simple controls, exploring mesmerizing minimalist landscapes. Collect epic coins, manage your pace, and toggle extreme mode for extra excitement. Can you reach the summit without falling?
